novel_features.name: AI Campaign Writer
novel_features.description: Describe a topic in plain English and get a complete, ready-to-send newsletter with subject line, preview text, and full HTML body.

novel_features.name: Subject Line A/B Generator
novel_features.description: Get 3 AI-generated subject line options with a rationale for each, then pick one before the draft is created.

novel_features.name: Batch Newsletter Scheduler
novel_features.description: Give it a file with one topic per line and it schedules one AI-written newsletter per topic, spaced out over coming weeks.

novel_features.name: Historical Open Rate Trends
novel_features.description: See how your open rates, click rates, and unsubscribes have changed over the last N days across all campaigns.

novel_features.name: Campaign Engagement Funnel
novel_features.description: A cross-campaign view of sent vs opened vs clicked vs unsubscribed to see your list health at a glance.

novel_features.name: Best Send Time Analysis
novel_features.description: Analyzes historical campaign data to identify which days and times correlate with your highest open rates.
